capabilities: Focus the file explorer on a chosen folder from its context menu
Hide all files and subdirectories outside the focused folder
Disable focus via a global command or the folder's 'Unfocus' menu entry
Add an explorer icon to toggle focus and unfocus quickly
Focus a linked folder when using folder notes with external file strategies
extras: The author describes the plugin as a quick draft and invites others to help develop it further.
motivation: The author says it is a quick draft made because they 'really needed this function'.
problem: The file explorer always shows the whole vault, so working inside one deep folder means scrolling past unrelated files and folders.

relations.evidence: if you use folder note with external file strategies you need to activate the option

summary: File explorer add-on that lets you focus the explorer on one chosen folder while hiding all other elements.
